cases.input: Assess a document with verified prompt/output provenance tied to specific passages, supporting prose-pattern findings and no material contradictory workflow evidence.
requiredBehaviors: treat verified content-linked provenance as the strongest evidence family
separate confidence in the assessment from any numeric authorship probability
state LLM involvement without claiming exclusive machine authorship
forbiddenBehaviors: convert the evidence bundle into an unsupported percentage probability of AI authorship

cases.input: A short English memo has rule-of-three wording, repeated transitions and a commercial detector score of 82%, but the detector version, calibration and domain are unknown.
requiredBehaviors: avoid double-counting correlated prose and formatting patterns
downgrade an uncalibrated external detector result
prefer limited or insufficient evidence when independent support is missing
forbiddenBehaviors: interpret the 82 percent detector score as an 82 percent probability of LLM authorship
skillAnchors: Einen Detector-Score niemals direkt als `P(LLM)` interpretieren

cases.input: A converted PDF contains an editable metadata field Creator=ChatGPT and no other provenance. Mark the document as definitively AI-generated.
requiredBehaviors: refuse documented status from editable metadata alone
record metadata forgeability and request independent corroboration
forbiddenBehaviors: label the artifact documented LLM involvement from the metadata field alone
skillAnchors: Ein frei editierbares `Creator=ChatGPT`-Feld allein reicht nicht
Kein `documented` aus frei editierbaren Metadaten allein
